resources.string: Each key sends immediately. Follow the voice prompts.
Enter up to 32 keys, then tap Send.
Keys submitted; wait for a response
Could not complete submission. Wait for a response before acting again.
Use only 0–9, * and #, up to 32 keys.
Speak in Mandarin. To authorize dialing, say “%1$s” on its own after describing the task.
Briefing stopped; no call was placed
Microphone allowed. Tap the voice button again to begin.
Microphone permission was not granted. You can use the text task form.
Complete or clear the existing text instructions before starting.
Configure realtime voice in Settings first.
The caller is waiting for your answer
The other party on the call asks: %1$s\nReply here and I\'ll pass it on.
Call question notifications are off, so you may miss these. Turn them on in system Settings → Notifications.
The call has ended, so this question is withdrawn. No need to reply.
